about: MUTINY 0.2.1 for Digitone OS 1.44: the author's released .elemod file, pinned unchanged.

mods.title: MUTINY (Eurorack-style sequencers)
mods.summary: Euclidean, Turing Machine and TB-3PO acid sequencers on each synth track, played from the encoders; YES writes a page into ordinary trigs.
mods.description: Euclidean, Turing Machine and TB-3PO acid sequencers from the Eurorack world on each Digitone mk1 synth track. Play them from the encoders and press YES to write a page into ordinary trigs. Unofficial and experimental: back up your projects first. Settings are saved per project.
mods.author: mbaumannn
mods.on_unit: As of 0.2: One Digitone mk1 on OS 1.44, about an hour through every feature (three models, page commits and undo, project save and reload, pattern switches, four tracks generating). No bugs found. Not tested with other mods on hardware.
